title: Data Type Constraints
prompt:
Write a program to demonstrate the constraints of different data types, such as the minimum and maximum values that can be stored.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Minimum value that can be stored in an integer variable: -2147483648
Maximum value that can be stored in an integer variable: 2147483647
